recommendation: Use Next.js App Router with strict TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma ORM against Postgres, NextAuth-style credential/session auth, and a server-side AI provider abstraction defaulting to a deterministic mock provider until production credentials are connected.
alternatives: tRPC-only backend with separate SPA frontend
reason: Master Spec requires strict TypeScript, Next.js App Router, Tailwind, and an accessible component foundation explicitly (§50). Prisma+Postgres gives durable, migratable, tenant-scoped relational state suited to Canonical Product State, Product DNA, Decision/Evidence/Event Ledgers, and billing entitlements. A single server-side provider abstraction satisfies the 'one intelligence, internally orchestrated' contract (§13) while keeping secrets server-side only (§4.7).
impact: Establishes the technical foundation for all of Phase 1-3; changing later is expensive.
customerResponse: n/a — routine technical decision within Execution Protocol §4 authority, no customer approval required.
